jython:import re

# Standardize the spelling and formatting of currency names
pattern = re.compile(r'[Dd]ollars|Drachmas', re.IGNORECASE)
value = value.lower() # convert to lowercase for case-insensitive matching
standardized_currency = pattern.sub('Dollars', value)

# Remove unnecessary whitespace and non-alphabetic characters
standardized_currency = re.sub(r'\s+|[^a-zA-Z]', ' ', standardized_currency).strip()

return standardized_currency
return value
